newsitem.title: USA: Basic Earth sees Q3 net loss.
newsitem.headline: Basic Earth sees Q3 net loss.

text.p: Basic Earth Science Systems said Friday it expects to report a net loss of about $73,000 or about one-half cent ($0.004) per share for its third fiscal quarter ending December 31, 1996.
It said it expects oil and gas sales revenue for the quarter to be about $808,000.
The company said it reported net income of $33,000 on revenue of $710,000 for the comparable quarter in 1995.
The company blamed increased production-related expenses for what it called the "disappointing loss."

Contributing to the loss, it said, were two unanticipated operations to recover subsurface equipment and increased depletion expense created by large capital additions to its "full cost pool" during the quarter.
Basic is an oil and gas exploration and production company with primary operations in south Texas and the Williston Basin in North Dakota and Montana.
